session.title: Haze-day Suito 3x8 tempo/torque development
session.purpose: Preserve this week's planned bike-specific aerobic-development stimulus without the high inhaled particulate dose of a two-hour outdoor MTB session in unhealthy haze.

dose.clean_air_gate: Train only in a materially cleaner indoor space: close doors and windows, avoid any fan that draws outdoor air inside, and use recirculating air conditioning and/or a non-ozone-producing particle purifier if available. A ceiling fan provides cooling but does not clean the air. Visible haze, smoke odour, eye or throat irritation, cough, wheeze, chest tightness or inability to separate the room from outdoor air closes the session.
dose.self_gate: Start only with mental clarity at least 8/10, no illness, gastrointestinal disturbance or pain, normal breathing at rest and symmetric fresh-enough legs.
dose.warm_up: Ride 12-15 minutes seated, progressing from 105 W toward 140 W. Confirm normal breathing, HR response, cadence and posture before the first repetition.
dose.main_set: Complete 3x8 minutes seated at 165-170 W, cadence 70-75 rpm and RPE 5-6, with 4 minutes at 100-115 W between repetitions. Rep three may rise toward 175 W only if rep two finishes at RPE 5 or lower with stable HR, cadence and posture.
dose.cool_down: Ride 10 minutes easy at 100-115 W. Total session is 60-70 minutes.
dose.fallback: If the physiological gate is merely yellow but indoor air is clean, replace the main set with 45-60 minutes at 116-125 W and RPE 2-3. If the clean-air gate fails, take complete rest rather than trying to train through smoke exposure.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: A controlled 24-minute tempo/torque dose at 78-81 percent of the current 211 W Garmin operational FTP will rebuild sustained bike-specific aerobic and muscular durability while avoiding the particulate exposure, technical consequence and sympathetic cost of outdoor riding in haze.
execution_rules: Use strong internal fan cooling, remain seated and keep the 12 mm aft saddle position unchanged.
Power and form govern the repetitions; HR is a response signal, not a target to chase.

Take a normal carbohydrate-containing meal beforehand. If the last meal was more than three hours earlier, take 20-30 g carbohydrate before or during the session. Drink approximately 500-750 ml per hour, with sodium according to indoor sweat loss.
Do not add standing torque, cadence drills, a fourth repetition or extra watts because the first two feel easy.
Prefer finishing by 19:00 so this moderate session does not consume the planned 23:00 sleep opportunity.

garmin_training_load.basis: Broad coach-selected range from Clayton's recent Suito load response; execution quality matters more than matching the estimate.

expected_result.session: All three repetitions stay within roughly 3 percent power spread, cadence and posture remain stable, rep three remains RPE 6 or lower, and no respiratory irritation appears.
expected_result.next_day: Normal cognition and legs with no disproportionate respiratory, sleep, autonomic, knee, back, hand or fit cost.

stop_rules: Do not train if the clean-air gate fails. Stop immediately for cough, wheeze, chest tightness, unusual shortness of breath, eye or throat irritation, dizziness or headache.
End the structured set for pain, an abnormal HR response relative to power and cooling, posture or cadence collapse, power loss above 5 percent, or if rep two already exceeds RPE 6.
Do not convert a stopped structured set into extra easy duration.
